name: Picture smoke
doc: The picture poured into a stable-fluid sim as its dye: swirls carry its colours off into smoke and the picture re-forms wherever the flow lets it, fastest right after each beat. The bass spins the swirls, the beat makes them breathe outward, onsets blow a burst out of a seeded spot, the mids lift the bright parts like hot air (luma buoyancy), the highs sharpen the eddies; fast eddies glint in the palette.

in.doc: the picture (its colours are the smoke), e.g. core-media.out

luma.doc: brightness for the buoyancy (bright rises); from the picture when unwired

cells.doc: fluid grid height in cells (width follows the aspect)

restore.doc: how fast the picture re-forms, per second (0 = it melts away for good)

snap.doc: extra re-forming right after each beat

memory.doc: half-life of the flow in seconds

breath.doc: outward push of the swirls on the beat

react.doc: how much the music drives the flow

buoyancy.doc: bright parts rise, dark parts sink (the mids add to it)

vorticity.doc: eddy sharpening (the highs add to it)

cycle.doc: palette drift of the glint, sweeps per 16 beats
